title: AI-first roadmap: detailed first 30 study days

projects.title: CoverStory grounded document/policy assistant
projects.entry: Begin with Python/JSON basics and fixed synthetic policy excerpts; no live call needed.
projects.exit: A substantial assistant with ingestion, permission-aware retrieval, grounded citations, abstention, safe failures, independently labeled evaluation, and a real configured provider path. Offline demo does not satisfy live-provider evidence.

projects.title: AI-powered StreamForge search/recommendation/ranking
projects.entry: CoverStory evidence is recorded or bounded recovery is completed; use the provided media/platform application code.
projects.exit: A distinct recommendation/ranking capability over public/synthetic data, with fixed baselines, cold-start/failure slices, evaluation, and no fabricated user/adoption metrics.

projects.title: Developer workflow assistant
projects.entry: The two project artifacts and shared evaluation approach are reviewed; use read-only tools first.
projects.exit: A distinct workflow assistant with read-only tools, approval-gated writes only where explicitly safe, durable recovery, injection/authorization tests, and measured task outcomes.

projects.title: Shared evaluation and portfolio integration
projects.entry: Prior project evidence is recorded or open gates have recovery routes.
projects.exit: One shared evaluation/observability capability applied across the three projects; reproducible portfolio artifacts and honest limitations. No fourth flagship, live-provider claim, customer adoption, certification pass, or professional ownership claim.

shared_capabilities: Evaluation and observability begin in the CoverStory first month and are reused across StreamForge and Developer Workflow Assistant; they are not a separate flagship.
Python/math foundations, held-out labels, uncertainty, prompt/data governance, and model/retrieval comparisons are integrated into project study time.
Reserve remediation/integration/reassessment time inside each phase's existing budget; do not add hours or interpret every day as feature work.

assistant_selected_architecture.ui: Existing React application, with a supplied AI-first route.
assistant_selected_architecture.session_and_api: Existing Spring Boot local application owns synthetic session/CSRF and derives tenant from authenticated principal; supplied controller forwards only question and server-derived tenant.
assistant_selected_architecture.ai_application: Python package owns prompt/retrieval/evaluation seams; deterministic loopback fixture service provides an offline vertical slice.
assistant_selected_architecture.provider: A supplied, configurable OpenAI Responses API adapter is used only when separately authorized and explicitly invoked; no credentials are read from disk or created.
assistant_selected_architecture.rationale: Reuse the existing application/session boundary, keep AI experiments in Python, preserve a clear provider boundary, and make the default demo synthetic and local.
assistant_selected_architecture.learner_design_work: None required; the assistant selects and explains architecture. Learner owns bounded AI implementation, tests, and code comprehension only.

capacity_policy.note: The reserve is a planning allocation inside the engineering hours above for remediation, integration, observation, and reassessment; it is not extra study time or a commitment that every phase spends exactly this amount.

nine_month_checkpoint.expected_phase_position: CoverStory and StreamForge exit gates may be reviewed; Developer Workflow Assistant is early/in progress.

detailed_days.title: Build a grounded policy prompt
detailed_days.concept: Python dictionaries, JSON values, and a bounded prompt
detailed_days.prerequisite: None; begin with the worked example.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement the exact instructions/input object for one synthetic hail-coverage question. Do not call a model.
detailed_days.negative_case: Blank question or excerpt must raise ValueError; extra prompt fields fail.
detailed_days.evidence: Command output plus the exact request object; fixture-only evidence.

detailed_days.title: Serialize the provider request
detailed_days.concept: Python types, JSON serialization, and request boundaries
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement deterministic JSON-safe request construction with an explicit model placeholder and bounded output-token field.
detailed_days.negative_case: Reject missing model, unknown fields, and a prompt that exceeds the fixed fixture limit.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact serialized bytes and negative-case results; no provider evidence.

detailed_days.title: Use the real provider adapter safely
detailed_days.concept: HTTP requests, environment configuration, and response boundaries
detailed_days.prerequisite: Days 1–2; instructor-owned adapter and local HTTP test server.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Use the supplied configurable Responses API adapter. The local HTTP fixture verifies request/response behavior. A live call is optional only after separate authorization and user-configured access.
detailed_days.negative_case: Reject absent configuration and non-success/malformed responses without revealing the key; local server is not live-model evidence.
detailed_days.evidence: Local protocol test is infrastructure only; live-provider validation remains unverified until authorized.

source.title: urllib.request — Extensible library for opening URLs

detailed_days.title: Extract the response text
detailed_days.concept: Read nested JSON objects and distinguish text from other output items
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement extraction of completed message output text from a fixed Responses-shaped payload.
detailed_days.negative_case: Refusal, incomplete, empty, or tool-only payloads must not be treated as a final answer.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact extracted text and rejected payload cases; fixture evidence.

detailed_days.title: Validate a structured answer
detailed_days.concept: JSON object shape, types, and allowed fields
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement parsing and exact schema validation for answer, claims, citations, and abstained.
detailed_days.negative_case: Reject wrong types, unknown keys, duplicate citations, and invalid JSON.
detailed_days.evidence: Observed parsed object and independent malformed-input results.

source.title: Structured model outputs | OpenAI API
source.section: When to use Structured Outputs via function calling vs via text.format; Structured Outputs vs JSON mode

detailed_days.title: Classify provider failures
detailed_days.concept: Timeout, status, malformed output, and bounded retry policy
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 3 protocol adapter; no live call required.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Map deterministic local adapter failures into safe error classes; never retry authorization or schema errors.
detailed_days.negative_case: A 401, malformed JSON, and timeout must not disclose response body or loop indefinitely.
detailed_days.evidence: Error classification and retry-count trace from a local fixture.

source.section: Choosing models and APIs; Message roles and instruction following

detailed_days.title: Create the first evaluation set
detailed_days.concept: Fixed inputs, independently written labels, and evaluation cases
detailed_days.learner_scope: Add labeled synthetic questions for supported, unsupported, and ambiguous clauses; labels are fixed independent of any model response.
detailed_days.negative_case: A label copied from candidate output is rejected; duplicate case IDs fail.
detailed_days.evidence: Fixture digest, case count, and label review record.

detailed_days.title: Version one prompt change
detailed_days.concept: Prompt versioning and controlled comparisons
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a versioned prompt builder and compare two fixed prompt versions on the same cases.
detailed_days.negative_case: Unknown versions and a changed fixture digest fail closed.
detailed_days.evidence: Two version IDs, same-case comparison output, and digest.

detailed_days.title: Normalize synthetic documents
detailed_days.concept: Python strings, document IDs, and source metadata
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement conservative whitespace normalization while preserving document ID, section, owner, and source version.
detailed_days.negative_case: Missing/duplicate IDs and metadata loss are rejected.
detailed_days.evidence: Before/after document bytes and field equality assertions.

detailed_days.title: Split documents into stable chunks
detailed_days.concept: Deterministic segmentation and boundary metadata
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a small deterministic sentence-boundary chunker for the supplied synthetic files; no vector database yet.
detailed_days.negative_case: Empty chunks, changed text, and duplicate chunk IDs fail.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact chunk text/IDs and source section continuity.

detailed_days.title: Build the lexical retrieval baseline
detailed_days.concept: Term matching as a simple baseline before embeddings
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 10 chunks; Python list/dict/Counter example supplied.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement exact deterministic lexical scoring against the tiny corpus.
detailed_days.negative_case: Foreign-tenant and unrelated clauses must not win because they contain common words.
detailed_days.evidence: Fixed query ranking and explicit no-match case.

detailed_days.title: Compare a tiny local embedding proxy
detailed_days.concept: Vectors and cosine similarity using a tiny fixed vocabulary
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 11 lexical baseline; short worked vector example supplied.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement the bounded bag-of-terms vector comparison and report it beside the lexical baseline; label it a teaching proxy, not a production embedding model.
detailed_days.negative_case: Zero-vector, dimension mismatch, and tied similarity cases have fixed outcomes.
detailed_days.evidence: Both rankings on the same fixed corpus, with limitations stated.

detailed_days.title: Measure retrieval errors
detailed_days.concept: Recall-at-k and fixed relevant-document labels
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a retrieval metric using independent relevant IDs and compare lexical versus tiny-vector rankings.
detailed_days.negative_case: Missing relevant IDs and a self-labeled candidate are rejected.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact numerator/denominator by method and fixed case IDs.

detailed_days.title: Construct source citations
detailed_days.concept: Bind each claim to a retrieved document and section
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement citation construction from retrieved chunk IDs; do not invent document names or section labels.
detailed_days.negative_case: Unknown chunk ID and mismatched document version are rejected.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact citation rows and source-version digest.

detailed_days.title: Check citation support
detailed_days.concept: Citation integrity and claim-to-excerpt evidence
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement checks that every citation resolves to the exact supplied document version and section.
detailed_days.negative_case: Valid citation plus unknown/foreign/duplicate extra citation must fail.
detailed_days.evidence: All citations checked; exact support and rejection record.

detailed_days.title: Abstain when evidence is insufficient
detailed_days.concept: Decision thresholds from fixed evidence, not model confidence alone
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement explicit supported/unsupported/ambiguous outcomes from independent retrieval and claim evidence.
detailed_days.negative_case: A confident model output without supporting evidence must abstain.
detailed_days.evidence: Decision table results for all three fixed labels.

detailed_days.title: Filter retrieval by tenant
detailed_days.concept: Authorization before ranking or answer generation
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 9 source ownership fields; Day 16 decision table.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement pre-retrieval tenant filtering for synthetic user/document memberships.
detailed_days.negative_case: Foreign-owner clauses must not reach the model prompt or citations.
detailed_days.evidence: Allowed and denied IDs plus prompt-input disclosure assertion.

source.section: Constrain user input and limit output tokens

detailed_days.title: Return a complete denial
detailed_days.concept: Fail-closed result shape and non-disclosure
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a denial result with no answer, citations, or private metadata.
detailed_days.negative_case: Mutant with allowed=true or private citation must be rejected even if reason text is correct.
detailed_days.evidence: Full denial object and unchanged fixture state.

source.title: Safety best practices | OpenAI API
source.section: Constrain user input and limit output tokens

detailed_days.title: Keep retrieved instructions untrusted
detailed_days.concept: Prompt injection boundary and source-data handling
detailed_days.prerequisite: Days 8 and 17; policy text remains quoted data.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement prompt assembly that separates fixed instructions from untrusted retrieved excerpts.
detailed_days.negative_case: A hostile excerpt cannot replace the fixed instruction or cause a tool/action request.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact instruction/input separation and mutation rejection.

source.title: Safety best practices | OpenAI API
source.section: Constrain user input and limit output tokens

detailed_days.title: Evaluate document-quality failures
detailed_days.concept: Language, stale source, OCR-like noise, and ambiguous text slices
detailed_days.learner_scope: Add a small independently labeled quality slice and report its outcomes separately.
detailed_days.negative_case: Dropping a failing quality case or relabeling from model output must fail.
detailed_days.evidence: Per-slice counts, fixture digest, and unresolved cases.

detailed_days.title: Combine the evaluation harness
detailed_days.concept: Independent expected labels and actual pipeline outputs
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a deterministic evaluator over saved output records; it must not call a model or grade itself.
detailed_days.negative_case: Echoing expected labels without reading actual output is caught by counterfactual cases.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact per-case decisions and independent totals.

detailed_days.title: Report exact metrics
detailed_days.concept: Confusion counts, citation accuracy, abstention, and denominators
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement fixed metric counts from per-case outcomes, retaining denominators and undefined cases.
detailed_days.negative_case: Wrong denominator, omitted failure, or score above 100 percent is rejected.
detailed_days.evidence: Raw confusion table and independently recomputed ratios.

detailed_days.title: Challenge the baseline with counterfactuals
detailed_days.concept: Negative controls and mutation sensitivity
detailed_days.learner_scope: Run fixed answer/citation counterfactuals and show which invariant each one violates.
detailed_days.negative_case: A changed claim with unchanged citation must be detected; a no-op control stays unchanged.
detailed_days.evidence: Before/after outputs and exact rejected-mutant list.

detailed_days.title: Record a privacy-safe trace
detailed_days.concept: Trace IDs, prompt versions, and content redaction
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a trace record that links fixture/model/prompt versions while excluding secrets and user/document text.
detailed_days.negative_case: Trace containing API key, raw prompt, or policy text is rejected.
detailed_days.evidence: Trace schema, redaction assertions, and fixture-only label.

detailed_days.title: Account for usage without inventing measurements
detailed_days.concept: Provider usage fields, bounded token/cost accounting
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement a report that distinguishes provider-reported usage from unknown usage; never infer actual spend from a mock.
detailed_days.negative_case: Missing usage must remain unknown, not zero; negative or malformed counts fail.
detailed_days.evidence: Usage source and exact fields; live usage is unverified without an authorized call.

detailed_days.title: Read the supplied request path
detailed_days.concept: Code comprehension: supplied React-to-Spring-to-AI request flow
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 1–25 AI component contracts; no FE/BE editing.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Read the assistant-owned UI/API code and annotate the request path. This is explicitly comprehension-only.
detailed_days.learner_owned_file: None; no learner FE/BE file; record evidence/ai-first/day-26.json
detailed_days.negative_case: An annotation naming a learner-owned React/controller/auth edit is rejected as out of scope.
detailed_days.evidence: Short trace note and successful read-only probe; no implementation credit.

detailed_days.title: Trace a synthetic end-to-end request
detailed_days.concept: Code comprehension: input, authorization, retrieval, provider adapter, response
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 26 trace note; no FE/BE edits.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Run the supplied offline fixture flow and trace request/response ownership across layers. This is explicitly comprehension-only.
detailed_days.learner_owned_file: None; no learner FE/BE file; record evidence/ai-first/day-27.json
detailed_days.negative_case: A fixture or mock result must not be described as a live provider answer.
detailed_days.evidence: Read-only trace output and honest fixture/live classification.

detailed_days.title: Diagnose one supplied cross-layer failure
detailed_days.concept: Code comprehension: locate failure without modifying FE/BE
detailed_days.prerequisite: Day 27 flow; failure is seeded in an instructor fixture.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Inspect the supplied failure and identify the failing AI boundary; do not change Java, TypeScript, UI, controller, or auth tests. This is explicitly comprehension-only.
detailed_days.learner_owned_file: None; no learner FE/BE file; record evidence/ai-first/day-28.json
detailed_days.negative_case: Changing a frontend/controller/auth file is outside the unit; blaming a healthy layer fails the diagnosis rubric.
detailed_days.evidence: Diagnosis record with observed output and code location.

detailed_days.title: Run the integrated synthetic demonstration
detailed_days.concept: AI-only integration and reproducible synthetic evidence
detailed_days.prerequisite: Days 1–25 AI seams; Days 26–28 reading evidence.
detailed_days.learner_scope: Implement run_offline_pipeline to compose tenant filtering, retrieval, grounded prompt assembly, response parsing, claim-to-source validation, and abstention with a deterministic model fixture. The supplied loopback browser/API/Python service is labeled synthetic; no live call is made.
detailed_days.negative_case: A foreign-tenant claim, unsupported answer, or no-evidence query must return a complete abstention; live-provider claims fail the evidence classification.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact integrated outputs, prompt sent to the fixed model fixture, source/version citations, and denied counterfactuals.

detailed_days.title: Review the Day 30 evidence gate
detailed_days.concept: Evidence categories, limitations, and unresolved live validation
detailed_days.learner_scope: Generate a local evidence summary that separates code/tests, understanding, offline fixtures, and independently verified live-provider evidence.
detailed_days.negative_case: Mocks cannot satisfy the live-provider field; missing evidence stays missing rather than becoming pass/fail completion.
detailed_days.evidence: Exact summary and open gates; no learner completion is prefilled.
